_about: Sound effects made with ElevenLabs sound effects v2 through fal (fal-ai/elevenlabs/sound-effects/v2) where no CC0 recording fitted. name: [prompt, seconds].
swing-1: a quick whoosh of a glowing energy blade cutting through the air, short and crisp, faint electric hum, no impact
swing-2: a fast swish of a humming energy sword slicing the air, bright and short, no impact
swing-3: a short sharp energy blade swipe, airy whoosh with a soft electric shimmer, no impact
swing-heavy: a heavy powerful energy blade sweep, deep whoosh with an electric crackle, no impact
rod-1: a soft magical energy bolt being cast, airy shimmering whoosh, gentle
rod-2: a small glowing magic orb launched from a staff, soft sparkling whoosh
bolt: a small fireball launched with a whoosh and a soft crackle
nova: a burst of freezing ice crystals spreading outward, crackling frost and a cold shimmer
mend: a gentle magical healing shimmer, soft rising sparkle, warm
dash: a very fast short dash whoosh, air and cloth, light footstep
die-1: a small cute creature being defeated, soft squeaky pop and a puff of dust
die-2: a little round critter popping into a puff of smoke, soft and cute
die-3: a small creature vanishing with a soft poof and a tiny squeak
claw-1: a small creature lunging attack, quick claw swipe whoosh, light
claw-2: a quick animal bite snap and swipe, short, light
elder-step-1: a giant stone golem footstep, heavy deep thud with a low rumble and pebbles scattering
elder-step-2: an enormous rock creature stomping once, deep heavy impact, gravel trickling
elder-roar: a colossal ancient creature roaring, deep echoing bellow, powerful, no words
elder-fall: a gigantic stone creature collapsing to the ground, massive crash, rocks tumbling, long rumble fading
rumble: deep earth rumble, the ground shaking, low and heavy, rocks grinding
shuttle-pass: a small spaceship flying past overhead, smooth whooshing engine passing by
shuttle-land: a small spaceship landing on a pad, thrusters powering down with a hiss and a soft thud
drink: drinking a potion from a small glass bottle, two quick gulps and a soft clink
lumen-burst: a radiant magical energy burst, bright whoosh with sparkles
teleport: a soft sci-fi teleport beam shimmer, rising whoosh with sparkles
saber-swing-1: a glowing plasma sword swung fast through the air, its deep electric hum swelling and bending in pitch as it passes, short
saber-swing-2: a quick swing of a humming energy blade, the electric drone rising and falling in pitch with the motion, short
saber-swing-3: a fast whipping plasma blade swing, buzzing electric hum with a doppler sweep, short
saber-swing-4: a short sharp flick of a humming energy sword, electric buzz sweeping past
saber-heavy: a big powerful two handed plasma sword sweep, loud deep electric hum surging and sweeping in pitch, crackle
saber-hum: the steady deep electric hum of a glowing plasma blade held still, constant low drone with a soft buzz, seamless
saber-hit-1: a plasma blade cutting into something, crackling electric sizzle and burn, short
saber-hit-2: an energy sword striking, sharp electric crackle and hiss, short
saber-hit-3: a humming plasma blade slicing through, fizzing electric crackle, short
saber-ignite: a plasma sword being switched on, a sharp electric snap then a rising hum settling into a steady drone
